headline: Shelf congested, not dry: slot b closed empty-handed, three titles under live work
lede: Slot b's warden target (#2695 Homebody rooms-with-purpose) was already claimed and actively pushed by slot a, and every other ladder rung came up empty: game-queue clear, feedback owned by a live QA session, the flagship four gap-free, and weakestStage null because the shelf's only open gaps sit inside held titles. #1711 was swept once more (store dry) and released. The factory is busy, not stalled.

notes.text: Homebody rooms with purpose (#2695) is mid-build on slot a — garden rooms tend and harvest by day, the wing lodges overnight, purpose joins the state hash.
PLAICRAFT #1711 stays in wait-state: the take store is dry and the phone-clap question (#2652) is with Jon until Nov 20 — the lane swept and released rather than spinning on it.
Next up when QA releases FloorBoss: aisle-clearance mechanics — swept cart bodies through turns instead of 1-cell blocks — already named as the weakest-stage gap.
The dry-queue guard held: jonq refused a new-flagship-title ask because the whole shelf isn't gap-free yet — congestion is not drought.

look.text: EXCITEBIKE: the PACK gate waits for its own toast (#2498 main-fix)
SMASH TV: the arcade gives no spawn invulnerability — NO MERCY (#2491)
